Title: Rowan ring versus blood rage or blood fury

Messages.Author: M.N.H. Wilkinson
Messages.Body:
I have recently had a game in which I had black cat with the rowan ring vs
Quinton Macdonald.I used the strike:paralyse on him and he used blood rage.I
thought he was paralysed but he argued that weapons against blood rage have no
effect.I looked on the card and it said that weapons used against blood rage
do NO DAMAGE not HAVE NO EFFECT.I gave up arguing and let him have his way but
I would like official confirmation one way or the other.Have I been cheated?
Mike(Lord of shadows)

indeed going to paralyze Quinton.
